text:
maria: Quick sync - want to lock marketplace SKU names + embargo windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Need final fallbacks for the joint announce doc by Wed.

lee: Short list of asks: vendor embargo windows, any known driver hotfix dates, and whether B200 is production-ready or purely burst.

tom: +1. Also need perf roughs so we can put them in the pricing tier table (P1/P2/P3). No long writeups, just median throughput and relative cost.

vendor-nvidia: Nvidia update: H100 GA planned 2026-06-20. Internal embargo: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-06-22. H200 still in validation; conservative estimate GA 2026-07-10. B200 cataloged as "burst" SKU; availability 2026-06-05 but limited initial slots.

vendor-amd: AMD update: MI300 GA now 2026-07-01. Requested embargo range 2026-06-20 -> 2026-07-02. We'll publish a microcode/driver refresh on 2026-06-25 for long-context stability.

vendor-graphcore: Gaudi update: GA 2026-05-30, embargo 2026-05-20 -> 2026-05-31. We'll provide perf matrices for BFloat/FP16 next week.

ash: Marketplace draft SKU list (feel free to edit):
```
sku_tags = [
  "rw-h100-48g-std-v1",
  "rw-h200-80g-std-v1",
  "rw-b200-32g-burst-v1",
  "rw-mi300-1536g-ml-v1",
  "rw-gaudi-1-32g-v1"
]
```
Please confirm canonical names by EOD Monday.

priya: Routing proposal (compact): H100 -> MI300 -> Gaudi -> B200 (burst) for enterprise SLA. For low-cost tiers, Gaudi primary > B200 fallback. We'll document per-region availability.

maria: Important: if H200 arrives with different memory config, we may need a separate SKU group instead of swapping under the same tag. Ops/marketplace to call out compatibility matrix.

lee: CI/lab ask: run forced-fallback job that moves active sessions H100->Gaudi under 70% load and verify KV cache integrity + token continuity. Add kv-checker to the lab harness.

tom: I'll add a short smoke in eng-runtime: "gpu-fallback-smoke" (30m) that validates latency p95 and no token corruption. Schedule tentative: 2026-05-26 04:00Z.

release-bot: [canary-sched] Canary window reserved 2026-05-26T04:00:00Z -> 2026-05-26T08:00:00Z for fallback smoke and driver hotfix validation.

priya: Comms note: We'll include embargo ranges from vendors verbatim in the joint press checklist. Marketing wants a 72h internal freeze before public announce. Blockers to surface now pls.

vendor-nvidia: Note: H100 initial capacity limited in ap-southeast region for first 2 weeks; recommend region-aware routing.

vendor-amd: Note: MI300 driver hotfix may require a rolling restart for long-lived pods; include in the pre-announce runbook.

maria: Action list I'll own: 1) Collate vendor embargo text into one doc. 2) Marketplace (ash) to confirm SKU tags and mark H200 as "TBD" if memory/sku mismatch. 3) Eng-runtime (tom) to add fallback-smoke job + kv-checker. 4) Comms (priya) to draft announce freeze language. Due: Wed COB.

ash: Acknowledged - will confirm tags and put a note on region capacity constraints.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone wants to be on the announce channel, DM me and I'll add you to the stakeholder thread. :white_check_mark:
